# Björn Eberhardt – Leben

> Semantic vector search and content-card API for Björn Eberhardt's portfolio page (leben.8bj.de). Explores profile "tiles" (documents and links) with multilingual support and a token-efficient TOON format.

Base URL: **https://leben.8bj.de**

## Public Search: `GET /api/tiles`

Semantic vector search across all visible cards. No authentication required.

### Query Parameters
- `q`: Vector search query string (e.g. `q=finance+investments`).
- `similar`: Card name to find semantically similar cards (e.g. `similar=finance`).
- *(Omitting both `q` and `similar` returns all cards in curated `sort_order`).*
- `offset`: Pagination offset (default `0`).
- `limit`: Number of cards to return (default `20`; `0` returns all).
- `lang`: Language preference (default `de`): `de`, `en`, `fr`, `es`, `pl`, `ro`, `sq`, `tr`, `ru`, `uk`, `ar`.
- `detail`: Detail level (default `snippet`).
  - `min`: metadata only (`name`, `tags`, `type`, `score`, `created_at`)
  - `snippet`: metadata + short summary cropped to 70 chars
  - `summary`: metadata + full summary
  - `full`: metadata + summary + full article body / HTML teaser / link
- `crop`: Character limit for summary/body (default `70` for `detail=snippet`, `0` = uncropped).
- `format`: `json` (default) or `toon`. Header `Accept: text/x-toon` also selects TOON.

### Optional Headers
- `X-Reference: <code1>,<code2>`: Unlocks cards protected by private reference codes.

### Response Formats
- **JSON**: `{"status":"success","query":"...","lang":"de","format":"json","count":N,"data":[Tile...],"items":[...]}`
  - Tile schema: `id`, `name`, `language`, `tags`, `title`, `html_teaser`, `summary`, `link`, `type` ("doc"|"link"), `content_file`, `visible`, `accent_color`, `background`, `sort_order`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `score` (0..1 relevance).
- **TOON** (`?format=toon` or `Accept: text/x-toon`): Tabular plain-text output (commented header line + one row per card). Optimized for low token usage in LLM prompts.

## Other Public Endpoints
- `GET /api/tiles/:name?lang=de`: Single card by name (falls back to another language if requested language is unavailable).
- `GET /api/tiles/:name/versions`: Available language versions for a card → `{"status","name","versions":[TileSummary...]}`.
- `GET /api/healthz`: Service health check → `{"status":"ok","db":"ok","time":"..."}` (HTTP 503 if database down).
- `GET /llms.txt`: This documentation file.

### Errors
Errors return JSON: `{"status":"error","message":"..."}`. Unknown card returns HTTP 404.

### Example Queries
- Vector Search: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=finance+investments&limit=3&lang=de](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=finance+investments&limit=3&lang=de)
- Similarity: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?similar=finance&limit=3&lang=de](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?similar=finance&limit=3&lang=de)
- Full Text in TOON: [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&limit=1&detail=full&format=toon](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?q=vision&limit=1&detail=full&format=toon)
- All Cards (compact): [https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?limit=0&detail=min&lang=en](https://leben.8bj.de/api/tiles?limit=0&detail=min&lang=en)

---

## Admin Endpoints
For authenticated management APIs (content CRUD, AI translation, background tasks, assets, and MCP), see [/llms-admin.txt](https://leben.8bj.de/llms-admin.txt).
